name: Analysis Review — Create PR for PO Approval
description: Triggered by BA after reviewing an epic or stories document. Collects feature name and PO GitHub username, creates a feature branch, commits the phase1 docs, pushes, and opens a PR with the PO as reviewer.

then.prompt:
The BA has triggered the analysis-review hook. You must now do the following steps in order:

1. Ask the BA for two inputs (ask both in a single message):
   - Feature name (e.g. `pbp-current-account`)
   - PO GitHub username (e.g. `john-doe`)

2. Wait for the BA to respond with both values.

3. Once you have both inputs, determine the document type:
   - If `docs/[feature-name]/phase1/[feature-name]-stories.md` exists and was recently created → branch suffix is `story-analysis`, PR title is `[Feature Name] — User Stories Review`
   - Otherwise → branch suffix is `epic-analysis`, PR title is `[Feature Name] — Epic Analysis Review`

4. Run the following git commands sequentially using the shell. Replace `[feature-name]` and `[po-github-username]` with the actual values provided:

```bash
# Step 4a — ensure we are on main/master and up to date
git checkout main
git pull origin main

# Step 4b — create and switch to feature branch
git checkout -b features/[feature-name]/epic-analysis
# (use 'story-analysis' suffix if generating stories branch)

# Step 4c — stage only the phase1 folder for this feature
git add docs/[feature-name]/phase1/

# Step 4d — commit
git commit -m "feat([feature-name]): add phase1 analysis documents for PO review"

# Step 4e — push branch
git push -u origin features/[feature-name]/epic-analysis

# Step 4f — create PR using GitHub CLI and add PO as reviewer
gh pr create \
  --title "[Feature Name] — Epic Analysis Review" \
  --body "## Phase 1 Analysis — Epic Document\n\nThis PR contains the generated Epic and Feature definitions derived from the BRD.\n\n### Review Checklist\n- [ ] All business requirements covered\n- [ ] BDD scenarios are accurate\n- [ ] Out-of-scope items not included\n\ncc @[po-github-username]" \
  --reviewer [po-github-username] \
  --base main
```

5. Report back to the BA with the PR URL returned by `gh pr create`.

6. Remind the BA:
   > Once the PO merges the PR, a GitHub Action will automatically mark the Approval Checklist as completed in the document. After that, you can return to @sdlc-analyst to generate the next phase document.
